definitions.gloss: second generation; successor; the second to hold a title or position
definitions.explanation: The second person to hold a particular name, title, or leadership position, especially in family businesses, traditional arts, or hereditary roles. Composed of {二|に} (two) + {代目|だいめ} (generation-counter).

examples.japanese: {二代目|にだいめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{継|つ}いだ→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧。
examples.english: The second-generation owner took over the shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二代目|にだいめ}⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As the second-generation president, he grew the company.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二代目|にだいめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{全国的|ぜんこくてき}→全国的：20017_zenkokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: This long-established shop became nationally known during the second generation's era.

notes:
USAGE:
{二代目|にだいめ} can be used on its own to refer to the successor, or before a title: {二代目|にだいめ}⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧ (second-generation president). The pattern extends to other numbers: ⟦{三代目|さんだいめ}→三代目：25201_sandaime⟧ (third generation), ⟦{初代|しょだい}→初代：11778_shodai⟧ (the first/founding generation). In traditional performing arts like ⟦{歌舞伎|かぶき}→歌舞伎：04455_kabuki⟧, stage names are inherited across generations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二代目|にだいめ}⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧ (second-generation company president)
- {二代目|にだいめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{継|つ}ぐ→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧ (succeed as the second generation)
- {二代目|にだいめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{継|つ}ぐ→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧ (the successor takes over the shop)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{初代|しょだい}→初代：11778_shodai⟧ refers to the founder or first holder of a title.
- ⟦{三代目|さんだいめ}→三代目：25201_sandaime⟧ is the third generation.
- ⟦{跡継|あとつ}ぎ→跡継ぎ：14299_atotsugi⟧ is a general term for successor or heir.
